searchText: So RE: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/486 are clients settling on setting `baseFeePerBlobGas` and `blobGasUsedRatio` value for pre-Cancun blocks to `0`? It looks like that's what `reth` and NetherMind are doing. <@508125616940515329> what did you land on? Likewise w/ `eth_blobBaseFee` I could see arguments for returning anything from `null` to `0` to a JSONRPC error pre-activation. We are still adding this 🙂 https://github.com/ethereumjs/ethereumjs-monorepo/pull/3295 We plan to add (?) blobs too
